title: Integration against POVMs in von Neumann algebras and Operational Quantum Reference Frames
summary: We construct integrals of uniformly bounded ultraweakly measurable functions against positive operator-valued measures (POVMs) in von Neumann algebras, assuming that the integrand algebra has separable predual. The integral lies in the spatial tensor product and is uniquely characterized by its evaluations on product normal states. Integration is unital and completely positive and descends faithfully to the quotient by POVM-null functions.
